outcome: first opioid prescription fill (<=5 days post-delivery)
second opioid prescription fill (6-60 days post-delivery)
cohort: Medicaid-enrolled women in Pennsylvania who delivered a liveborn neonate vaginally from 2008 to 2013, excluding women who used opioids during pregnancy or who had an opioid use disorder.
finding: 12% of Medicaid-enrolled women filled an outpatient opioid prescription within 5 days after vaginal delivery, and among those, 14% filled a second prescription 6-60 days later, with tobacco use and mental health conditions being predictors for the initial fill.
